hypothesis: Showing explicit peer-generated code improves official acceptance versus identical information channels with that code field masked.
architecture: Frozen private-note restart architecture; no peer diagnosis sharing.
intervention: Replace only each latest-peer code string with a fixed withholding marker. Leave all policies, task prompts, own notes, peer outputs, acceptance, errors and outcome history unchanged for the given history. Apply the existing restart operation afterward.
stopping_rule: Complete all four full126 trajectories regardless of intermediate score. Do not tune prompts or add repetitions based on results.
primary_endpoint: Mean across two repetitions of the paired difference in final official acceptance (shared minus masked).
analysis: For each of 42 task families, average the paired difference over its three SDKs and two repetitions. Bootstrap these 42 family averages 20000 times, fixed seed20260916, percentile95 CI. Also report each repetition, gained/lost cases, all costs, and activation histories. Two repetitions do not estimate all model variability.
interpretation_rule: Call the effect consistently supported within this setup only if both repetition differences are positive and the family bootstrap95 lower bound is above0. Otherwise distinguish a positive point estimate from inconclusive/negative evidence. No claim of isolated semantic correctness or token-matched improvement.
limitations: Development benchmark and model, reused common initial126.
Peer observations evolve independently in each condition; protocols are fixed, observed values need not remain equal.
Error tracebacks may contain incidental source snippets; this ablates the explicit full peer-code field, not every possible code fragment.
The same policy mentions peer code in both arms; a missing-code marker is used without rewriting policy.
Not a no-peer-information comparison or a token-matched comparison.
Previous108 and107 runs are historical context, not primary controls or selectively pooled samples.
recovery_rule: Never silently resample an existing raw call. Completed exit0 responses rejected only for the known transport fallback notice may be recovered verbatim in the same worker with preserved hashes, no new model call. Other infrastructure errors are surfaced.
